clause_text: Aligned: passes financial gate + Aligned gate 2 (values link): Creative entrepreneurship
summary: YouTube Partner Program pays independent creators.
caveat: The creator program is one part of a much larger business (search, cloud, advertising).

evidence.publisher: Alphabet Inc. Form 10-K FY2025, Item 1 Business (SEC EDGAR)
evidence.quote: YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program.

market_cap.note: Public float (non-affiliate shares) used as a floor for market cap.
